/stretch-film.summary: Stretch film (pallet wrap) is the stretchy plastic film that locks boxes to a pallet so the load ships as one unit. Hand film is pulled by hand; machine film runs through a stretch wrapper.
keyQuestions: How many pallets a day do you wrap?
Typical load weight and whether corners are sharp

/stretch-film/hand-film.summary: Hand stretch film: 12"–18" rolls on a 3" core that you pull around the pallet by hand. The everyday choice for anyone wrapping fewer than about 40 pallets a day.
useCases: Hand-wrapping pallets in a shipping room
Bundling pipe, lumber and long parts
keyQuestions: Load weight and shape — uniform boxes or irregular?
Do you want a lighter pull (pre-stretched) or maximum toughness (blown)?

/stretch-film/hand-film/cast.summary: Cast hand film is the clear, quiet, high-cling standard: easy to pull, easy to see through, and available from 55 to 120 gauge so you can match it to the load weight.
useCases: Everyday pallet wrapping of boxed goods
Wrapping where you need to read labels through the film
keyQuestions: Load weight: under 1,200 lb (55–63 gauge), 1,200–2,500 lb (70–80), heavier (90+)?

/stretch-film/hand-film/blown.summary: Blown hand film is tougher and more puncture-resistant than cast at the same gauge, with a one-sided cling that stays put — the pick for sharp corners, heavy loads and loads that get dragged.
useCases: Pallets with protruding corners or metal parts
Heavy loads that need high retention
keyQuestions: Are corners sharp or is the load irregular?
Is roll noise a concern on the floor?

/stretch-film/hand-film/pre-stretched.summary: Pre-stretched hand film arrives already stretched, so it is feather-light to pull, uses up to half the film of standard rolls and wraps a pallet with far less effort and wrist strain.
useCases: Crews wrapping many pallets by hand
keyQuestions: Do you already use a dispenser?

/stretch-film/hand-film/bulk-pre-stretch.summary: Bulk pre-stretched hand film: pre-stretched rolls packed for volume users — the same light pull and film savings, bought by the skid.
keyQuestions: Delivery to one site or several?

/stretch-film/hand-film/color-tinted.summary: Color-tinted hand film wraps and color-codes at the same time — route loads, flag customers or hide contents, with the same cling and stretch as clear cast film.
useCases: Color-coding pallets by customer, route or priority
keyQuestions: Which colors and how many of each?
Do you need opaque (black/white) or just tinted?

/stretch-film/hand-film/extended-core.summary: Extended-core hand film has the core sticking out past the film so you can wrap holding the roll itself — no dispenser needed, nothing to misplace.

/stretch-film/hand-film/banding-film.summary: Banding film is narrow (2"–5") stretch film for bundling small items together: pipe, molding, boxes in a stack — fast, clean, no residue.
useCases: Replacing tape or twine on bundles
keyQuestions: How many rolls at a time?

/stretch-film/hand-film/loadstar-ultra.summary: LoadStar Ultra hand film is a premium high-performance film: thinner gauges that outperform standard 80 gauge, with excellent cling and tear resistance.
useCases: Cutting film cost without losing load retention
Heavier loads on a hand roll
Shipping rooms upgrading from economy film
keyQuestions: What gauge are you using today?

/stretch-film/hand-film/spartan.summary: Spartan hand film is a heavy-duty engineered film for demanding loads that would tear through ordinary cast film.

/stretch-film/hand-film/torque.summary: Torque hand film is a high-strength film made to be pulled hard: more holding force per wrap for tight, stable loads.
useCases: Loads that need high containment force

/stretch-film/machine-film.summary: Machine stretch film runs through a stretch wrapper's pre-stretch rollers at 200–300%, so each pallet uses less film and holds tighter and more consistently than hand wrapping.
keyQuestions: Which wrapper, and what pre-stretch does it run?

/stretch-film/machine-film/cast.summary: Cast machine film: clear, quiet, high-cling film for stretch wrappers, in gauges from light to heavy. The default roll for most turntable and arm wrappers.
useCases: Everyday machine wrapping of boxed loads
Loads where labels must stay readable
keyQuestions: Roll width and core your machine takes?

/stretch-film/machine-film/blown.summary: Blown machine film gives higher load retention and puncture resistance for heavy, sharp or irregular loads run through a wrapper.

/stretch-film/machine-film/color-tinted.summary: Color-tinted machine film for color-coding or concealing machine-wrapped loads.

/stretch-film/machine-film/loadstar-ultr.summary: LoadStar Ultra machine wrap is a premium thin-gauge film that stretches further and holds more than standard film, cutting film cost per pallet on high-volume wrappers.
useCases: High-volume wrappers looking to reduce film spend
Loads that need high retention at low gauge

/stretch-film/machine-film/nexus.summary: Nexus machine film is an engineered multi-layer film for high pre-stretch wrappers: thin, strong and quiet.

/stretch-film/machine-film/ultimate-forc.summary: Ultimate Force machine film delivers maximum holding force for heavy and unstable loads on stretch wrappers.

/stretch-film/machine-film/uvi-film.summary: UVI machine film has UV inhibitors so wrapped loads can sit outdoors in the sun without the film degrading and letting go.
useCases: Lumber, pipe and building materials stored outside
keyQuestions: How long do loads sit outside?

/strapping.summary: Strapping (banding) is the flat band — steel, polyester, polypropylene or woven cord — that bundles product or unitizes a pallet, closed with seals, buckles or a weld.
keyQuestions: What are you strapping and how heavy is it?
Does the load settle or shrink after strapping?

/strapping/steel.summary: Steel strapping is the strongest, stiffest band available — the standard for heavy, rigid, hot or sharp-edged loads like steel coils, structural metal and big lumber units.
useCases: Steel coils, sheet and structural metal
Loads with sharp edges that would cut plastic strap
keyQuestions: Strap width and thickness your tools take (3/8", 1/2", 5/8", 3/4", 1-1/4")?

/strapping/steel/regular-duty.summary: Regular-duty steel strapping handles most bundling and palletizing of heavy goods; sold by the coil and priced per coil, with matching seals.
keyQuestions: Width and gauge your tensioner/sealer take?

/strapping/steel/heavy-duty.summary: Heavy-duty steel strapping in thicker gauges for very heavy or oversized loads that need maximum break strength.

/strapping/steel/high-tensile.summary: High-tensile steel strapping has the highest break strength per width — for extreme loads where regular-duty strap would stretch or snap.
useCases: Steel coils and heavy metal products
keyQuestions: Width and thickness your tools take?

/strapping/steel/mini-coils.summary: Mini coils of steel strapping: smaller, lighter coils that fit hand dispensers and portable tools for occasional or job-site strapping.

/strapping/steel/zinc-coated.summary: Zinc-coated (galvanized) steel strapping resists rust for loads stored outdoors, shipped by sea or held for months.
useCases: Anything that sits in the weather

/strapping/steel-strap-seals.summary: Steel strap seals are the metal sleeves crimped over overlapping steel strap ends with a sealer; match the seal to the strap width and duty.
keyQuestions: Open (snap-on) or closed (threaded) seals for your sealer?

/strapping/steel-buckles-for-plastic-and.summary: Wire buckles close polyester cord and poly strapping by hand — thread, pull tight, done. No sealer and the strap can be re-tightened.
useCases: Cord strapping and hand-grade poly strap
Lumber, pipe and bundles that settle

/strapping/metal-seals-for-plastic-strap.summary: Serrated metal seals for poly and polyester strapping, crimped with a sealer for a strong, tamper-evident joint.
useCases: Closing poly and polyester strap with hand tools
Loads that need a secure, non-reusable joint

/strapping/magazine-seals.summary: Magazine (clip-fed) seals load into pneumatic and magazine-fed sealers so the operator never handles loose seals.

/strapping/plastic-buckles-for-poly-stra.summary: Plastic buckles close hand-grade poly strapping with no tools — fast, cheap, and safe for light bundles.

/strapping/plastic-strapping.summary: Plastic strapping comes in two materials: polypropylene (poly) for light, economical bundling and polyester (PET) for heavy loads that settle. Both are rust-free, light and safe to cut.
keyQuestions: Load weight and does it settle?
Hand tools, friction-weld tool or a machine?
Core size your dispenser takes (8x8 or 16x6)?

/strapping/plastic-strapping/poly.summary: Polypropylene (poly) strapping is the economical strap for light-to-medium bundling: cartons, newspapers, small pallets. It stretches under load, so it's not for loads that settle or heavy freight.

/strapping/plastic-strapping/poly/machin.summary: Machine-grade poly strapping is wound on 8"x8" or 9"x8" cores to feed arch, tabletop and semi-automatic strapping machines smoothly.
keyQuestions: Strapping machine model and core size?

/strapping/plastic-strapping/poly/signod.summary: Poly strapping made to run in Signode strapping machines and tools, at distributor pricing.

/strapping/plastic-strapping/polyester.summary: Polyester (PET) strapping is the modern replacement for light steel: high break strength, holds tension as loads settle, no rust and no sharp edges. Joined with serrated seals or a friction weld.
useCases: Export loads that ride a long way
keyQuestions: Load weight and break strength needed?
Hand tools, battery friction-weld tool, or machine?

/strapping/plastic-strapping/polyester/e.summary: Embossed polyester strapping has a textured surface that grips seals and friction welds better, for machines and heavy loads.
useCases: Heavy loads that need the strongest joints

/strapping/plastic-strapping/polyester/s.summary: Polyester strapping made to run in Signode PET tools and machines.

/strapping/cord-strapping.summary: Cord strapping is woven or bonded polyester yarn that you tension by hand and close with wire buckles — no sealer, re-tightenable, and gentle on the load. A favorite in lumber and agriculture.
useCases: Loads that settle and need re-tightening
keyQuestions: Do you have a cord tensioner?

/strapping/baling-wire.summary: Baling wire ties bales of cardboard, paper and scrap and secures bundles where strapping won't do: hand-tie wire in precut lengths with loops, or automatic baler wire by the skid.
keyQuestions: Baler make and model, or hand tie?
Skid lots or by the box?

/corrugated-boxes.summary: Corrugated shipping boxes (RSC style) in 200# burst test and lightweight 32 ECT, from 3" cubes to 46" long, sold by the bundle with volume pricing. Sizes are inside dimensions, L x W x H.
keyQuestions: Inside dimensions you need (L x W x H)?

/corrugated-boxes/200-pound-test.summary: 200 lb burst-test boxes resist punctures and rough handling — the traditional choice for parcel shipping and heavy or dense contents.

/corrugated-boxes/lightweight-32-ect.summary: 32 ECT boxes use a bit less board, so they are lighter and cheaper while stacking just as well on a pallet — ideal for lighter goods shipped palletized.

/corrugated-boxes/white-rsc-3.summary: White corrugated RSC boxes for a clean presentation — retail, gift and direct-to-consumer shipments where the box is part of the product.

/tape.summary: Packaging tape for every seal: hot melt and acrylic carton sealing tape, water-activated kraft tape, filament strapping tape, masking and duct tape, plus the dispensers that make them fast.
keyQuestions: What are you taping — box weight and board type?

/tape/carton-sealing-tape.summary: Carton sealing tape: 2" and 3" rolls of clear or tan tape for closing shipping boxes by hand or machine.
keyQuestions: Hand rolls (55 yd) or machine rolls (110 yd / 1000 yd)?

/tape/carton-sealing-tape/hot-melt-tape.summary: Hot melt carton sealing tape has aggressive instant tack and strong holding power on recycled board — the workhorse tape for busy shipping rooms. 1.6 mil economy for light boxes, 1.9 mil performance for medium-weight boxes.
keyQuestions: Box weight: economy (1.6 mil) or performance (1.9 mil)?

/tape/carton-sealing-tape/natural-rubber.summary: Natural rubber carton sealing tape sticks instantly in cold rooms and on rough board where hot melt and acrylic struggle.
keyQuestions: Temperature the box is sealed and stored at?

/tape/carton-sealing-tape/label-protecti.summary: Clear label protection tape goes over shipping labels and packing lists so they survive rain, scuffs and handling.

/tape/acrylic-tape.summary: Acrylic carton sealing tape is clear, UV-stable and ages well — the choice when sealed boxes sit in storage, ride in hot trucks or need to look clean.

/tape/acrylic-tape/pre-printed-tape.summary: Pre-printed carton sealing tape (Fragile, Handle With Care, This Side Up) seals the box and warns the handler in one pass.

/tape/paper-tape.summary: Paper tape: water-activated (gummed) kraft tape that bonds into the box for a tamper-evident, recyclable seal, and flatback kraft tape for splicing and sealing.
keyQuestions: Do you have a wetting dispenser?

/tape/strapping-tape.summary: Filament (fiberglass-reinforced) strapping tape bundles, reinforces and closes heavy cartons without strapping tools; rated by tensile strength (utility, 190#, 300#).

/tape/masking-tape.summary: Masking tape in economy, general-purpose and painter's grades for finishing, bundling and temporary labeling.

/tape/duct-tape.summary: Cloth duct tape for repairs, bundling and sealing where a strong, tearable tape is needed.

/tape/tape-dispensers.summary: Tape guns and dispensers for 2" and 3" carton sealing tape — the fastest upgrade for anyone sealing boxes by hand.

/bags.summary: Poly bags in every mil and shape: flat and gusseted bags, reclosable (zipper) bags, poly tubing for custom lengths, anti-static bags and t-shirt bags. A mil is one-thousandth of an inch — more mils, tougher bag.
keyQuestions: Bag size (W x L) and thickness (mil)?
What goes in it — weight and sharp edges?

/bags/flat-poly-bags.summary: Flat poly bags: open-top polyethylene bags in widths from 2" to 60", in 1 to 6 mil. Thin for light parts and produce, 2 mil for general use, 4–6 mil for heavy or sharp parts.
keyQuestions: Quantity per case or cases per month?

/bags/gusseted-poly-bags.summary: Gusseted poly bags expand at the sides to hold boxes, bulk product, drums and pails — the right shape when the contents have depth.

/bags/poly-tubing.summary: Poly tubing is continuous polyethylene tube on a roll: cut to length and heat-seal both ends to make custom bags for odd-sized parts. Pink anti-static tubing for electronics.
keyQuestions: Do you have an impulse sealer?

/bags/poly-tubing/pink-anti-static.summary: Pink anti-static poly tubing dissipates static so circuit boards and electronic parts can be bagged safely.

/bags/reclosable-bags.summary: Reclosable (zipper) poly bags in 2 mil and 4 mil for kits, samples and small parts that get opened and closed; also available with a hang hole for retail.

/bags/reclosable-bags-with-hang-hole.summary: Reclosable bags with a hang hole for pegboard and retail display of parts, hardware and samples.

/bags/t-shirt-bags.summary: T-shirt (merchandise) bags with handles for counter sales and will-call pickups.

/cushioning.summary: Protective packaging that absorbs shock and stops things moving inside the box: bubble wrap, foam, kraft paper, newsprint, corrugated pads and packing peanuts.
keyQuestions: What are you protecting and how fragile is it?
Roll width your table can handle?

/cushioning/bubble-wrap.summary: Bubble wrap rolls (3/16" small bubble, 1/2" large bubble) perforated for easy tearing; standard, anti-static and eco grades.

/cushioning/bubble-wrap/anti-static.summary: Pink anti-static bubble wrap for wrapping circuit boards and electronics without static buildup.

/cushioning/bubble-wrap/eco-cell.summary: Eco-Cell bubble uses recycled content and a lighter structure for greener cushioning with the same protection.

/cushioning/foam.summary: Polyethylene foam: thin foam sheets and rolls (1/32"–1/2") to protect finishes and separate parts, and plank foam (1.2–2.2 lb density) for heavy-duty cushioning and fabricated inserts.
keyQuestions: Sheets or rolls, and what width?

/cushioning/kraft-paper-rolls.summary: Kraft paper rolls (12"–72" wide) for void fill, wrapping, interleaving and bench covering — recyclable, fast and cheap.

/cushioning/newsprint.summary: Unprinted newsprint sheets and rolls for wrapping dishes, glassware and small items — lighter and cleaner than kraft.

/cushioning/butcher-paper.summary: Butcher paper rolls for food wrapping, table covering and clean surface protection.

/cushioning/reinforced-scrim-paper.summary: Reinforced scrim paper is kraft with a fiberglass scrim laminated in — tear-resistant wrap for heavy or sharp items and outdoor covering.

/cushioning/corrugated-cushioning.summary: Corrugated pads and single-face corrugated rolls: layer pads for pallets, dividers, wrap for furniture and protection for edges.
useCases: Pallet layer pads and tier sheets

/cushioning/packing-peanuts.summary: Loose-fill packing peanuts fill the voids around odd-shaped items so nothing shifts in the box.
keyQuestions: Do you need a dispenser hopper?

/edge-protectors.summary: Edge protectors (angleboards, corner boards) slide under strapping or stretch film at the corners of a load to spread strap tension, stiffen the stack and keep film from cutting on sharp edges.
useCases: Keeping stretch film from tearing on corners
keyQuestions: Length (match load height) and leg size (2x2 or 3x3)?

/edge-protectors/light-duty.summary: Light-duty edge protectors (around .120" thick) for boxes and light cartons under stretch film or poly strapping.

/edge-protectors/medium-duty.summary: Medium-duty edge protectors (around .160") for the typical mixed pallet strapped with polyester or wrapped tight.

/edge-protectors/heavy-duty-edge-protect.summary: Heavy-duty edge protectors (.225" and up) for lumber, metal, brick and anything strapped hard with steel or polyester.

/edge-protectors/strapping-edge-protecto.summary: Small strapping protectors sit under the strap line only, protecting the corner right where the strap bites.
useCases: Steel and polyester strapping on cartons

/edge-protectors/do-not-double-stack-edg.summary: "Do not double stack" cones and protectors sit on top of a pallet so carriers won't stack another load on it in transit.

/labels.summary: Labels for shipping and warehousing: pre-printed stock labels (Fragile, This Side Up, hazmat, inventory), direct thermal and thermal transfer label rolls for Zebra-class printers, laser labels and printer ribbons.
keyQuestions: Pre-printed message or blank for a printer?
Printer make and model (direct thermal or thermal transfer)?

/labels/stock-printed-labels.summary: Pre-printed stock labels on rolls — Fragile, Handle With Care, This Side Up, arrows, hazmat, climate, inventory and more — in bold colors handlers notice.
keyQuestions: Label size and rolls per order?

/labels/direct-thermal-labels.summary: Direct thermal label rolls print without a ribbon on Zebra, Datamax, Sato and similar printers — the standard for shipping labels and short-life barcodes.
keyQuestions: Label size and core (1" desktop or 3" industrial)?

/labels/thermal-transfer-labels.summary: Thermal transfer labels print with a ribbon for durable, smudge-proof barcodes and product labels that must last — in white and colors, rolls or fan-fold.
useCases: Labels exposed to heat or abrasion

/labels/premium-ribbons.summary: Thermal transfer printer ribbons (wax, wax/resin, resin) for Zebra, Datamax, Sato and Intermec printers.
keyQuestions: Ribbon width, length and type (wax / wax-resin / resin)?

/mailers.summary: Mailers for parcel shipping: kraft and poly bubble mailers, lightweight poly mailers, and bubble pouches (standard and anti-static) for protecting small items.
useCases: Protecting parts and electronics in transit

/mailers/anti-static-bubble-pouches.summary: Pink anti-static bubble pouches protect boards and components from both impact and static.

/mailing-tubes.summary: Kraft mailing tubes with end caps for shipping drawings, posters, rods and anything long and rollable.

/mailing-tubes/end-caps.summary: Plastic end caps that close kraft mailing tubes.

/packing-list-envelopes.summary: Self-adhesive packing list envelopes (clear, Packing List Enclosed, Invoice Enclosed) that stick to the carton and keep paperwork with the shipment.

/poly-sheeting.summary: Polyethylene sheeting (visqueen) in clear, black and flame-retardant grades, plus paint and acoustic masking film — for covering, containment, moisture barriers and job-site protection.

/poly-sheeting/flame-retardant.summary: Flame-retardant poly sheeting meets fire codes for enclosures, containment and temporary walls on job sites.

/poly-sheeting/paint-and-acoustic-film.summary: Paint masking film and acoustic film: lightweight plastic that clings to surfaces for overspray protection and sound-barrier work.

/rope-and-twine.summary: Rope, twine and pull tape: truck rope and tarp rope, poly and nylon rope, tying twine for bundles, seine twine, and conduit pull twine and measuring pull tape for electrical work.
keyQuestions: Twisted or braided, poly or nylon?

/rope-and-twine/california-truck-rope.summary: California truck rope: 3-strand poly rope made for tying down loads and tarps on flatbeds and trailers.

/rope-and-twine/1-ply-industrial-poly-ty.summary: Industrial poly tying twine for bundling, tying bags and general shop use — cheap, strong and rot-proof.

/rope-and-twine/utility-conduit-pull-twi.summary: Conduit pull twine for pulling electrical wire and cable through conduit.

/rope-and-twine/herculine-cable-measurin.summary: Herculine measuring pull tape: flat, pre-lubricated polyester tape marked in feet for pulling cable and measuring conduit runs.

/tarps-and-pallet-covers.summary: Covers that keep weather, dust and dirt off goods: pallet covers, lumber bags and covers, drywall covers, bin liners, bun rack covers, and tarps with tarp straps.
useCases: Protecting pallets in storage and transit
keyQuestions: Load dimensions (W x D x H)?
Mil thickness and clear or black?

/tarps-and-pallet-covers/pallet-covers.summary: Poly pallet covers (bags) in clear and black, 1.5–3 mil, sized to drop over a standard pallet to keep dust and moisture off the load.
useCases: Dust and moisture protection in storage

/tarps-and-pallet-covers/lumber-bags-and.summary: Lumber bags and covers: heavy poly covers and bags that keep rain and UV off lumber units, millwork and building materials stored outdoors.

/tarps-and-pallet-covers/drywall-covers.summary: Poly drywall covers keep moisture and dirt off stacked drywall and sheet goods on the job site.

/tarps-and-pallet-covers/bin-liners.summary: Large poly bin liners for gaylords, totes and bulk bins.

/tarps-and-pallet-covers/bun-rack-covers.summary: Clear poly bun rack (bakery rack) covers keep dust off racked product in bakeries and food plants.

/tarps-and-pallet-covers/tarps-and-tarp-.summary: Poly tarps and rubber tarp straps for covering truck loads, equipment and outdoor storage.
